exposure: prolonged second stage of labor (2 hours vs. 3 hours)
finding: Extending the second stage of labor in women attempting TOLAC was associated with a lower repeat cesarean delivery rate but an increased risk of instrumental delivery, uterine rupture, fetal acidemia, and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Extending the second stage of labor in women attempting TOLAC was associated with a lower repeat cesarean delivery rate but an increased risk of instrumental delivery.
